snippet.title: The Florist - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for The Florist, a classic survival exploration adventure game developed by Unclear Games. Players will traverse a town overgrown with deadly yet beautiful flowers. Solve ingenious puzzles, defeat horrifying enemies, and uncover the mystery behind a plan to create new life in the most inhuman way imaginable. The Florist is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
